readings.title: Planning a university project
readings.description: Planning a university project. Read the conversation and listen to each speaker.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 我们下星期五要交项目报告。
turns.translation: We need to submit the project report next Friday.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 我们先分工吧。我负责收集数据。
turns.translation: Let us divide up the work first. I will collect the data.

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 好，我来分析数据和写报告。
turns.translation: Good, I will analyze the data and write the report.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 星期三下午在图书馆讨论结果，可以吗？
turns.translation: Can we discuss the results at the library on Wednesday afternoon?

turns.speaker: a
turns.text: 可以。请在星期二晚上之前把数据发给我。
turns.translation: Yes. Please send me the data before Tuesday evening.

turns.speaker: b
turns.text: 没问题。我会先检查数据，再发给你。
turns.translation: No problem. I will check the data before sending it.

questions.explanation: Lin states 下星期五要交项目报告.
Chen takes responsibility for collecting data.

questions.prompt: When should the data be sent?
